description: This file defines the 'Coupon' model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework, providing methods for retrieving and managing coupon data, including validation, product/category associations, and history tracking.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: The Coupon class provides operations for fetching coupon details, validating coupon conditions, associating coupons with products and categories, and managing coupon usage history within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves detailed coupon information if the coupon code is valid and applicable, including product associations and scope checks.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches a coupon record from the database based on the coupon code if the coupon is active.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns a list of product IDs associated with the specified coupon.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of category IDs associated with the specified coupon.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Records the application of a coupon in the coupon history table.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes all coupon history entries associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of times the coupon has been used.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByCustomerId
methods.description: Returns how many times the coupon has been used by a specific customer.
